title: Opportunities for the renewable energy transition via reactive carbon capture
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00741G, Viewpoint
Eleanor Kearns, Rachel E. Siegel, Deanna M. D’Alessandro, Ji-Woong Lee, Louise A. Berben
This viewpoint article gives a brief overview of reactive carbon capture (RCC) and its relationship to traditional carbon capture (CC) technologies and discusses possible roles for RCC in the transition to a renewable energy economy.
